newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TENNIS-KREMLIN CUP FAVOURITES THROUGH TO SEMIS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KREMLIN CUP FAVOURITES THROUGH TO SEMIS.

text.p: Yevgeny Kafelnikov and Goran Ivanisevic, the Kremlin Cup's top two seeds, eased their way safely into the semifinals on Friday.

Russian top seed Kafelnikov sealed his place in the next round by subduing the initially strong challenge of Zimbabwe's Byron Black 7-6 6-2. He now meets German David Prinosil who overcame another Russian, Andrei Olkhovsky, 7-5 6-2.
Second-seeded Ivanisevic also dismissed his opponent, the Czech Republic's Petr Korda, in straight sets, 7-5 6-0.
Ivanisevic will play American Alex O'Brien, ranked 48th in the world, in the other semifinal. O'Brien beat Dutch outsider Sjeng Schalken 6-3 7-6.
